integrity_rules: Any change to either candidate component invalidates this freeze and requires a new candidate version/freeze.
Development fixtures are public and must not be relabeled held-out.
No library admission or QUALIFIED claim may be made from static preflight or development fixtures alone.
Held-out thresholds, judge configuration, corpus identity, repeat policy and stop conditions must be preregistered before scored candidate outcomes are visible.
Practical qualification must include direct mobile and desktop rendered-artifact evidence.
